correctness.rationale: Conjugating the orthonormal-frame coordinates under the specified inner-product convention gives the complex conjugate of tr(W^T C W); skew perturbations contribute zero. Takagi congruence gives the sum of the weighted squares of the frame entries, bounded by sum_i s_i p_i with p_i the projection diagonal (0<=p_i<=1, sum p_i=k). The leading k coordinate frame attains the leading partial sum. For k=1 an isotropic vector on the first two coordinates gives zero, including when the second weight vanishes; if both vanish then C=0. For even k the 2x2 unitary blocks give zero diagonal in UU^T. For odd k>=3 the residual triple cancels using cos(2 theta)=-c/(a+b) in [-1,0], with an all-zero exception harmless. For example at n=k=3 and weights (4,2,1), the last construction gives trace 6*(-1/6)+1=0 while the identity gives 7. The path-connected complex Stiefel manifold and common-phase action then supply exactly the closed disk, including k=n and zero radii. Successive differences and Takagi uniqueness give the classification. VERIFICATION.md and verify_trace_disks.py were inspected; the package's 1,056 cases / 10,560 checked frames are recorded toleranced evidence, not an independent rerun. The exact hand check above is replayable by evaluating tr(DUU^T) for U=(cos(theta) I_2+i sin(theta) [[0,1],[1,0]]) direct-sum 1.
